_doc: Expected verdict per query id (§6). DF.* (unsat) and M.drop.* (sat) are GENERATED at runtime from blanket rules so indices never rot; only explicit named queries live here. Any verdict != expectation -> nonzero exit. REDUNDANT-FOR-GOAL reclassification is keyed by the SHA-256 fingerprint of the dropped constraint's canonical JSON in 'reclassifications', never by index.

SAN.load.justification: strict schema + structural set-diff + Round decode + ledger + K two-source all hold

SAN.field_equiv.justification: fast Mersenne+condsub mod-p reductions proven bit-exactly equal to the brief-mandated `urem p` for all operands in [0,p) (A9)

SAN.fips_kat.justification: fips.py rotation/K/Sigma/full-abc-digest KATs validate the exact functions used in the z3 goal

SAN.honest_numeric.justification: all 64 honest rows: bind_on&bind_off constraints=0, table axioms hold, FIPS next-state matches, rows chain

SAN.forged_numeric.ch.justification: ch-forged row satisfies bind_off+tables, violates bind_on at [5,6], violates G

SAN.forged_numeric.maj.justification: maj-forged row satisfies bind_off+tables, violates bind_on at [13,14], violates G

SAN.goal_sat.justification: FS antecedent + un-negated G is satisfiable -> G is not a contradiction

SAN.no_constraints.justification: with base constraints removed, Not(G) is satisfiable -> constraints are load-bearing, G not a tautology of the trusted base

SAN.honest_z3.0.justification: pinned honest row 0 satisfies constraints+tables+I_res+I_out+G (validates z3 encoding)

SAN.forged_z3.ch.justification: pinned ch-forged row satisfies bind_off+tables+Not(G) (Rust-constructed corroboration of M.bind_off)

SAN.fs_vacuity.bitwise.justification: L_ch/L_maj shared antecedent (RANGE+ENABLER+non-cubic constraints+AND/XOR axioms+E,F,G,A,B,C ranges) is SAT-alone -> not vacuously UNSAT

SAN.fs_vacuity.new_e.justification: L_new_e antecedent (RANGE + new_e-path TripleSum carry relations + boundary 16-bitness, intermediates FREE) is SAT-alone

SAN.fs_vacuity.new_a.justification: L_new_a antecedent (RANGE + new_a-path TripleSum carry relations + boundary 16-bitness, intermediates FREE) is SAT-alone

FS.main.justification: THEOREM (aggregate): PASS iff every FS.L_* lemma is UNSAT. The chain + structural ledger cover ALL 50 yielded-output conjuncts (copy/increment: ledger node-identity; new_a/new_e: L_new_a/L_new_e; schedule out: L_sched). SAN.goal_coverage asserts no conjunct is left unclassified

FS.L_new_e.justification: FAITHFUL (no intermediate-range crutch): yielded word(OUT[10,11])=new_e == m32(D + m32(H+Sigma1+Ch+K+W0)) via the new_e-path TripleSum carry relations lifted mechanically from the cubics to pure LIA; intermediates c82,83/c84,85 FREE in [0,p)

FS.L_new_a.justification: FAITHFUL: yielded word(OUT[2,3])=new_a == m32(T1 + m32(Sigma0+Maj)) via the new_a-path carry relations; intermediates c82,83/c84,85/c116,117 FREE in [0,p)

FS.L_sched.justification: constraints + Schedule table axiom force word(OUT[48,49]) == sigma1(W14)+W9+sigma0(W1)+W0 (schedule output; previously prose-only)

N.res.8.justification: dropping d-lo range assumption admits a Sigma1-input-wrap forgery

N.res.9.justification: dropping d-hi range assumption admits a forgery

N.res.16.justification: dropping h-lo range assumption admits a forgery

N.res.17.justification: dropping h-hi range assumption admits a forgery

N.out.2.justification: new_a lo range never value-forced elsewhere: carry-cubic freedom permits non-canonical (carry,res)

M.bind_off.justification: PR #1425 under-constraint: ch_limb/maj_limb cols unpinned; forgery model must exhibit word(limb_pair) != word(recombine_pair)

V.table.and_free.justification: dropping c==a&b (ranges kept) floats Ch/Maj bytes -> FS genuinely uses AND semantics

V.table.xor_free.justification: dropping c==a^b (ranges kept) -> FS genuinely uses XOR recombination

V.table.and_norange.justification: keeping c==a&b but dropping AND operand ranges breaks DF.in4 -> derived forcing rests on table ranges (Split16 adds no constraint)

V.spec.sigma1_rot.justification: goal Sigma1 rotr6->rotr7 makes Not(G) reachable -> proof binds the exact Sigma1

V.spec.sigma0_rot.justification: goal Sigma0 rotr2->rotr3 -> proof binds the exact Sigma0

V.spec.sched_sigma.justification: goal schedule sigma1 shift 10->9 -> schedule conjunct sensitivity

V.spec.k_perturb.justification: goal K[20]^=1; solver picks t=20 (t symbolic per row)

V.spec.endian_swap.justification: goal new_a lo/hi swapped -> kills the universal-fatal lo/hi-swap encoding-bug class

generated_rules.DF.*: unsat  (constraints + table semantics force the limb/counter range)
generated_rules.M.drop.*: sat  (every individually dropped non-enabler bind_on constraint admits a forgery)
